name: window-spaces-native
description: macOS-only Node addon that reads and re-assigns a window's Mission Control Space via the private SkyLight (CoreGraphics Services) API, so ZenNotes can send each window back to the Space it was on before the app quit — the BetterTouchTool 'Move Window to Desktop X' route, which works from a normally signed app. Electron windows never enrol in AppKit window restoration (which is how native apps carry their Space across relaunch), so this is the only way to persist per-window Space assignment.
